title: Data Curation and Model Souping: Unlocking Qwen3-0.6B for MS MARCO Passage Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2610.14816v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This report studies passage retrieval and re-ranking on the MS MARCO benchmark using lightweight Qwen3-0.6B models. Across three experimental settings --- BM25-then-reranking task, corpus-wide dense retrieval task, and dense retrieval then re-ranking task --- the results demonstrate that competitive ranking performance can be achieved without complex architectural modifications, custom loss functions, or cross-encoder distillation. Instead, substantial gains stem from data-centric strategies: corpus-targeted continued pre-training, rigorous data curation, hard-negative mining, training--inference distribution alignment, and weight merging via Model Soup. In particular, Model Soup delivers marked performance gains while preserving the inference efficiency of a single model. translated_title: 数据精选与模型融合：释放Qwen3-0.6B在MS MARCO段落排序任务中的潜力
translated_abstract: 本报告研究了使用轻量级Qwen3-0.6B模型在MS MARCO基准测试上的段落检索与重排序问题。在三种实验设置下——BM25先检索后重排序任务、全语料库密集检索任务以及密集检索后重排序任务——结果表明，无需复杂的架构修改、自定义损失函数或交叉编码器蒸馏，即可实现具有竞争力的排序性能。相反，显著的性能提升源于以数据为中心的策略：面向语料库的持续预训练、严格的数据精选、难负例挖掘、训练与推理的分布对齐，以及通过Model Soup（模型汤）进行的权重合并。特别值得一提的是，Model Soup在保持单模型推理效率的同时，带来了显著的性能提升。这些发现突显了数据精选和权重合并技术如何能够将十亿参数以下的模型推向最先进的性能水平。
tldr: 通过面向语料库的持续预训练、严格数据精选、难负例挖掘及Model Soup权重合并等以数据为中心的策略，轻量级Qwen3-0.6B模型无需复杂架构修改即可在MS MARCO段落排序任务上达到最先进性能。
en_tdlr: Data-centric strategies—including corpus-targeted continued pretraining, rigorous data curation, and Model Soup weight merging—enable the lightweight Qwen3-0.6B model to achieve state-of-the-art MS MARCO passage ranking performance without complex architectural modifications.
